run_parallelized_gif_generation: run the script to generate a GIF from a trajectory file using parallel POV-Ray rendering
run_pov_from_atoms: run pov_from_atoms to render a single frame POV-Ray image from an ASE atoms object
run_parallelize_generation: run parallelize_generation to create POV-Ray images and compile them into a GIF from a traj file
run_get_parser: run get_parser to build an argparse parser with traj-path, out-path, and num-workers arguments
run_cli_gif_maker: run the CLI module with --traj-path, --out-path, and --num-workers to generate a GIF from a trajectory
